PASS_POINTS: Separates product-only P0 findings from preactivation control blockers using evidence-backed semantic relevance rather than severity alone.
Preserves V16-RC1.3 terminal nonblocking statuses RESOLVED, CLOSED, and SUPERSEDED.
Treats incomplete denominator state as UNKNOWN rather than zero.

BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.ISSUE: The projection output is not explicitly bound to the exact complete finding-universe snapshot/root from which it was derived.
BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.RISK: A previously valid projected root/count can be replayed after the FINDINGS universe changes, so OPEN_CONTROL_P0_COUNT==0 would not itself prove clause [062] complete-manifest derivation.
BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.REQUIRED_CHANGE: Require SOURCE_CONTROL_SNAPSHOT plus COMPLETE_FINDING_MANIFEST_ROOT_HASH (and preferably classification-manifest/root version) in every projection result; recomputation must fail closed when any binding changes.

BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.ISSUE: P0_CLASS_RULE defines positive P0 mappings but does not explicitly define null, missing, malformed, or unmapped severity as a projection-blocking condition.
BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.RISK: A control-relevant finding with malformed severity could fail the P0-class predicate and disappear from CURRENT_CONTROL_P0 rather than making zero unprovable.
BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.REQUIRED_CHANGE: Define missing/null/unparseable/unmapped severity as CLASSIFICATION_UNKNOWN that makes OPEN_CONTROL_P0_COUNT UNKNOWN until authoritative severity classification evidence is supplied.

BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.ISSUE: INPUT_REQUIREMENTS mixes raw finding-manifest fields with derived fields control_relevance, classification_evidence, and canonical_blocker_id.
BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.RISK: Implementations can become circular or disagree on whether enrichment is part of source enumeration or projection.
BLOCKING_REVIEW_FINDINGS.REQUIRED_CHANGE: Split SOURCE_ROW_REQUIRED_FIELDS from DERIVED_CLASSIFICATION_FIELDS and define the deterministic transform between them.

ADDITIONAL_GUARD: A SUPPORTING_DUPLICATE parent should count as valid only when the parent exists in the same bound complete manifest and its control relevance/status are valid under the same projection generation; otherwise downgrade to UNKNOWN.
